# free-b2b-sourcing

> Free B2B product & supplier sourcing for AI agents. A self-contained agent skill that drives the free web version of Accio Work (accio-com-buyer-assistant) through a connected browser and returns structured JSON: suppliers, manufacturers and wholesalers with price ranges, MOQ, store ratings, reorder rates, on-time delivery and certifications. No paid API, no API key.

## When to use

Use when an agent or user needs **live** B2B supplier or product sourcing data (MOQ, prices, ratings, verified status) for a specific product keyword, and has a signed-in accio.com browser session available.

Do NOT use for: talent/recruiting sourcing, retail shopping, general knowledge questions that do not need a live query, or any task that would contact suppliers or place orders without explicit user approval. Default behavior is query and compare only.

## Use

- Skill instructions: free-b2b-sourcing/SKILL.md (workflow, query playbook, output schema, error codes, safety boundary)
- Driver: free-b2b-sourcing/scripts/sourcing.mjs
  - `runSourcing(tab, { query, constraints? })` — Qoder entry point; returns `{ ok, layout, items, excluded?, raw, source }`
  - `runSourcingWithAdapter(adapter, opts)` — platform-agnostic entry point; adapter spec in scripts/adapters/INTERFACE.md
  - `parseSourcingText(text)` — pure function, no platform dependency; reusable in any adapter
  - `validateConstraints(items, { maxMOQ?, maxPrice?, country?, verifiedOnly?, minRating? })` — pure function; returns `{ items, excluded }`
- Layouts: `suppliers` (supplier cards), `products` (product cards), `agent-json` (opt-in `jsonMode`, best-effort — limited testing has not confirmed reliable output), `text` (compare/trend/inquiry/logistics answers)
- `constraints` option: post-filters parsed items client-side; violations moved to `out.excluded` with reason strings. Prices compared in displayed currency (often CN¥).
- Requires: Qoder `browser-use` Tab interface for `runSourcing`; any adapter implementing INTERFACE.md for `runSourcingWithAdapter`. Browser profile must be signed in at www.accio.com (free tier).
- Qoder adapter: free-b2b-sourcing/scripts/adapters/qoder.mjs — `createQoderAdapter(tab)`
- Attribution URL used by the driver: https://www.accio.com/work/app?src=f_seo-github-skill&defaultAgent=accio-com-buyer-assistant&language=en

## Safety boundary

- Query and compare only by default. Do not click `Chat now`, send inquiries, or initiate supplier contact without explicit user approval.
- Never fabricate results. If the run times out, returns empty, or the parser fails, report the failure state explicitly.
- Validate constraints client-side. `requirement_match` is surfaced but not guaranteed; items outside stated constraints may appear.
- Credentials stay with the user. The driver never types or infers passwords. `LOGIN_REQUIRED` triggers a manual handoff.

## Platform adapter status

| Platform | Status |
|---|---|
| Qoder browser-use | Verified end-to-end |
| Grok Bot (cloud browser) | Adapter needed |
| OpenClaw | Adapter needed |
| Claude Code / Desktop | Adapter needed |
| Cursor | Adapter needed |

## Example

Query: "Find 5 suppliers of stainless steel insulated water bottles, MOQ under 500, with price ranges"
Result item (suppliers layout): `{ "type": "supplier", "name": "...", "source": "Alibaba.com", "years": 4, "region": "Zhejiang", "country": "CN", "metrics": { "Store rating": "4.8/5.0 (5)", "On-time delivery": "97.6%" }, "products": [{ "price": "CN¥27.03", "min_order": "1 piece" }] }`
